column1: # Normalized expected edges. Hand-written ground truth: each row was derived from the
# fixture's original audit labels (written before DevMap ran) and the language's own
# semantics, never from DevMap's output. Read by devmap-analyze/tests/accuracy_fixtures.rs.
#   caller    symbol id `<file>::<qualified name>`; a bare path means the file node
#   callee    symbol id(s). `a|b` = any one satisfies; `a&b` = all must be present
#   kind      edge   = a Calls/References/Instantiates/Extends/Implements/... edge, any tier
#             import = an Imports edge between the two files
#             forbid = NO edge of any kind at confidence >= 0.9 may join caller and callee
#   level     must   = a correct resolver has this edge
#             should = the audit accepted an honest miss or an alternative here
#   ledger    optional `a|b` bare names a ledger row may carry when the expected callee's
#             own name is not the name written at the call site

# known_failing.tsv (keyed by the card that owns the fix).
